questions.q: By whom were the holy men of God moved when they spoke?
questions.evidence: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man: but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit

questions.q: Whom does Peter call a preacher of righteousness?
questions.evidence: and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly

questions.q: With the Lord, one day is as how many years?
questions.evidence: But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day
